method: actual Chrome via cua_repl, generated Diamond UI, real PostgreSQL, transparent response gate; manual action record

cases.name: initial-signin-create-workspace-project-issue
cases.observed: Signed in as alice; actual UI created workspace/project/issue and displayed exactly one authorized issue.

cases.name: user-assisted-scoped-credential-issuance
cases.observed: User clicked one-hour read credential; metadata names three declared read operations, owner alice, epoch1. Raw secret was hidden and is not retained in this receipt.

cases.name: empty-password-change-rejection
cases.observed: Both password fields empty; click rejected and existing private workspace remained available.

cases.name: user-assisted-password-change
cases.observed: User entered disposable current/new passwords and submitted; UI reported Password changed. Sign in again.; all password fields and private data cleared. Independent DB epoch2, zero sessions, credential epoch1.

cases.name: persisted-password-change-after-restart
cases.observed: Old password rejected; new password signed in and read persisted authorized issue after real server restart.

cases.name: initial-competing-event-regression
cases.observed: Held actual logout_all200 after commit; competing First page canceled client logout. Read denied but private issue and workspace remained in DOM. DB independently had zero sessions.

cases.name: final-held-identity-competing-click-and-input
cases.observed: Held actual committed logout_all200; clicked First page and edited bound workspace input. Working remained pending and no competing RPC was forwarded. Release completed logout; private issue absent, workspace and credential empty, All account sessions ended visible.

cases.name: final-truncated-identity-reply
cases.observed: Real committed200 headers and first byte delivered, remainder dropped. UI displayed mutation uncertainty; private issue, signed-in state, workspace and credential were all cleared.

cases.name: zero-byte-identity-connection-loss
cases.observed: Gate closed before response bytes. Chrome repeated the transport request: actual first logout_all200, repeated logout_all401. UI displayed denial and cleared private issue, signed-in state and workspace. No claim of transport exactly-once delivery.

cases.name: final-recovery-after-identity-loss
cases.observed: Fresh sign-in with the changed test password and authorized issue read succeeded; final held logout replay cleared caches again.

cases.name: frozen-final-fresh-fixture-full-app-and-recovery
cases.observed: Documented --gated fixture started real PG plus final Diamond. Actual Chrome signed in, created workspace/project/issue, loaded one authorized issue, passed held logout competing click/input and truncated200 body clearing, then freshly signed in/read and signed out with private data cleared.

gaps: Enrollment/verification/recovery/disable/API lifecycle exercised in the bounded independent real HTTP/PG campaign, not every control in Chrome.
Password change and credential issuance required user browser handoff on the intermediate artifact; final artifact rechecked persisted password authentication and account state.
No public TLS/proxy deployment or production capacity qualification.

The zero-byte transport-repeat case ran on the immediately preceding artifact; the final epoch guard additionally prevents stale identity failures from clearing a newer identity. Cross-component stale401 cleanup was reviewed but not separately forced in Chrome.
